attempts.summary: Built the TLS-secured Vault Transit provider on node1 and a healthy three-voter integrated-Raft cluster on node2–node4. Raft members automatically unseal through Transit, KV v2 contains the required proof, failover succeeded, and all four hosts passed sequential restart verification. node1’s Transit provider itself uses manual Shamir unseal; the three Raft members use automatic Transit unseal as requested.
